explanation: The statement says that taking the w-th archimedean component of the image of the inclusion of GL₂(F_w) into the adelic GL₂ gives back the original element. It is phrased entirely in terms of the library's own definitions: archComponent, glArch, adelicArchGLInclAt, adelicArchGLIncl and archGLIncl. None of these are Mathlib constants. The proof unfolds the definitions and rewrites with two of the library's own lemmas, glArch_adelicArchGLIncl and archComponent_archGLIncl_self. Its content therefore lies in the library's definitions, so no Mathlib declaration can carry it.
